# CreateTimer <img class="product" src="media/bb-20x14.png" alt="BlitzBasic" title="BlitzBasic" width="20" height="14">

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [Language Features](Language-Features) · [Time & Date](Language-Features-Time-and-Date)

</div>


```blitzbasic
CreateTimer:Int32 hertz:Int32
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `hertz` | In | Int32 | required | Ticks per second, above 0. |

**Returns:** A timer handle.

## Description

Creates a timer that ticks a given number of times per second. [WaitTimer](WaitTimer) waits for the next tick, which keeps a loop at a steady speed without depending on how fast the computer is.

## Examples

```blitzbasic
timer = CreateTimer(50)
For i = 1 To 5
	WaitTimer(timer)
Next
FreeTimer timer
Print "five ticks at 50 per second"
```

```text
five ticks at 50 per second
```
